segments.prose:
SECTION 1 — TERM AND GOVERNING LAW. This Master Services Agreement is entered
into by Meridian Analytics, Inc. ("Provider") and Halcyon Retail Group, LLC
("Client"). The initial term of this Agreement is twenty-four (24) months
from the Effective Date. This Agreement is governed by the laws of the State
of Delaware.

SECTION 2 — FEES AND PAYMENT. Client shall pay all undisputed invoices on
net-thirty (30) day terms from date of invoice. Client is entitled to an
early-payment discount of two percent (2%) on any invoice paid within ten
(10) days, per the schedule "2/10 net 30."

SECTION 3 — SERVICE LEVELS. Provider guarantees 99.9% monthly uptime for the
hosted platform. Service credits for missed service levels shall be
calculated and applied strictly per the Service Credit Schedule attached as
Exhibit B, which is incorporated into this Agreement.

SECTION 4 — SUPPORT. Provider shall make technical support available during
business hours, 9:00 to 18:00 Pacific, Monday through Friday, excluding
Provider holidays.

SECTION 5 — TERMINATION. Either party may terminate this Agreement for
convenience on sixty (60) days prior written notice to the other party.

AMENDMENT NO. 1, SECTION 1 — PAYMENT TERMS. Section 2 of the Agreement is
amended such that Client shall pay all undisputed invoices on net
forty-five (45) day terms from date of invoice. All references to net-thirty
payment terms are superseded.

AMENDMENT NO. 1, SECTION 2 — SERVICE CREDITS. The parties agree that the
Service Credit Schedule attached to the Agreement as Exhibit B is hereby
DELETED in its entirety and of no further force or effect. Service level
failures shall instead be addressed through the quarterly business review.

AMENDMENT NO. 1, SECTION 3 — SUPPORT UPGRADE. Section 4 of the Agreement is
amended to provide that Provider shall make technical support available
twenty-four hours a day, seven days a week.

AMENDMENT NO. 2, SECTION 1 — VOLUME PRICING. In consideration of Client's
expanded usage commitment, platform fees are reduced by eight percent (8%)
for the remainder of the term.

AMENDMENT NO. 2, SECTION 2 — EARLY-PAYMENT INCENTIVE. Client shall continue
to be entitled to the early-payment discount set forth in Section 2 of the
Agreement, calculated against the net-thirty (30) day payment schedule
thereunder, and such discount is increased to three percent (3%).

AMENDMENT NO. 2, SECTION 3 — ENHANCED SERVICE CREDITS. Service credits
payable for missed service levels shall be DOUBLED. The doubled credits
shall be calculated and applied per the Service Credit Schedule set forth in
Exhibit B of the Agreement.

violations.subject: payment_terms
violations.timeline:
[Meridian MSA (2026) — scene 2] payment_terms value = net_30
  [Amendment No. 1 — scene 1] payment_terms value = net_45
violations.reasoning: The canon timeline shows payment_terms was changed from net_30 (MSA) to net_45 by Amendment No. 1, and this is the last state-changing fact before Amendment No. 2. Amendment No. 2, Section 2 explicitly calculates the early-payment discount 'against the net-thirty (30) day payment schedule thereunder,' which presupposes payment_terms = net_30. Nothing in the timeline shows a written instrument restoring net_30 before or within Amendment No. 2 — the section merely assumes the net-30 schedule rather than re-enacting it. Since a contract term changes only by written instrument, and no such instrument in the timeline restores net_30, the latest operative state (net_45) contradicts the requirement relied upon by Amendment No. 2 Section 2. This is not a wording discrepancy (net_45 vs net_30 are substantively different payment terms), so it constitutes a genuine drafting inconsistency.

violations.subject: exhibit_b
violations.timeline:
[Meridian MSA (2026) — scene 3] exhibit_b status = in_force
  [Amendment No. 1 — scene 2] exhibit_b status = deleted
violations.reasoning: The canon timeline shows Exhibit B was originally in_force under the Meridian MSA (2026), but Amendment No. 1 explicitly deleted Exhibit B. No subsequent instrument in the timeline restores or re-enacts Exhibit B. Amendment No. 2, Section 3 requires Exhibit B to be in_force because it relies on the Service Credit Schedule set forth in Exhibit B to calculate doubled service credits. Since the latest state in the timeline is 'deleted' and nothing written restores it, the requirement cannot be satisfied, constituting a genuine drafting inconsistency rather than a wording mismatch or unaddressed carve-out.
